verdict.rationale: GitLab's evidence gestures at governance concepts ("rules and guardrails you set" for automated agents, and "audit-ready evidence" collected in pipelines) which imply some approval/guardrail capability, but there is no explicit documentation in this pack of merge request approval rules, protected environments, or deployment approval gates specifically required before production release. missing for 10: explicit merge-request/approval-rule docs, protected-environment/deployment-approval docs, independent corroboration that approval gates are enforced in practice.
